title: Batch
description: What a sender POSTs to /api/v1/ingest. At most 100 messages and 8 MiB encoded.

version.description: The batch format version. It changes only for a breaking change.

message.description: One piece of evidence, or a heartbeat. The body's schema depends on kind.

id.description: 1 to 200 bytes of UTF-8 without NUL. Unique for its system for ever.

kind.description: config_snapshot, population, event_proof or heartbeat. A receiver answers unsupported for a kind it doesn't know.

collected_at.description: When the evidence was collected. At most five minutes ahead of the receiver's clock.

body.description: The kind's body: config_snapshot.schema.json, population.schema.json, event_proof.schema.json or heartbeat.schema.json.
